verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core abstraction is exactly this: an Agent is an autonomous unit that performs tasks and makes decisions, and Tasks are explicitly delegated to Agents (with Crews and Flows coordinating multi-agent delegation), backed by extensive first-party docs and a no-code Visual Agent/Task Builder plus Crew Studio for less-technical setup. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the delegation experience specifically framed as talking to a single 'assistant', and any evidence of a conversational assistant UI rather than code/YAML-defined agents.
